Alongside the launch of the all-new Twelve South Airfly Drive wireless CarPlay adapter at $40, Amazon has once again updated its early fall Prime Day sale with fresh deals. Today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by M5 MacBook Air models up to $150 off as well as the ongoing $500 price drop on this M5 Pro 2TB model and the single 2026 Apple AirTag 2 down at Amazon all-time low pricing. We also have Sharge’s metal 300W smart display power bank at $50 off, loads of new all-time lows on Belkin’s 25W MagSafe charging stations, and the now live official fall Prime Day deals on the Eve Matter/HomeKit plugs, light switches, outlets, and more from $32. Scope it all out below.

Twelve South launches new Airfly Drive wireless CarPlay and Android Auto adapter

Just after launching some early fall Prime Day deals, Twelve South is ready to launch its all-new Airfly Drive today. The latest entry in the Airfly lineup, the new CarPlay and Android Auto adapter is live and available for purchase at $39.99. There’s a ton of no name brands out there making something similar (and usually much less elegant than this), but Twelve South has arrived.

Complete vehicle compatibility list for new Twelve South Airfly Drive CarPlay and Android Auto adapter

M5 MacBook Air models up to $150 off in early fall Prime Day sale

Outside of some official Apple refurb deals that sell out very fast, Amazon’s early fall Prime Day sale has delivered the best deals on Apple’s current-generation M5 MacBook Air and we are tracking as much as $150 off select models right now.

There are three configurations you’ll want to draw your attention to right now – the base model and 24GB 15-inch, and this mid-range 13-inch. If you must have a different model, hold off for now:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,449 (Reg. $1,599)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,399 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB$1,849 (Reg. $1,999)

You’re looking at $150 off the list prices here on the two upgraded configs and $100 off the base 15-inch. At this point, these are the discounts you are aiming for – deals on the base models have been rare so the $100 drop is solid and you’ll want to side-step any of the upgraded configs until they are $150 off.

This deal also joins what I would consider to be among the best MacBook deals over the last several months – the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and 2TB of storage capacity at $500 off the list price.

This M5 Pro MacBook Pro at $500 off might be the best early fall Prime Day deal yet

The early Amazon fall Prime Day sale is flying with thousands of price drops, but there is one particularly notable Apple deal we want to highlight before it disappears. There’s no telling how things might go with the latest MacBook Pro lineup for Prime Day next week, but you can already score a giant $500 off this M5 Pro 2TB model.

Now available in both the Space Black and Silver colorways, Amazon is offering the 14-inch MN5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM, the 2TB storage capacity, and the upgraded 18/20-Core internals down at $2,699 shipped.

You can still score a single 2026 Apple AirTag 2 down at Amazon all-time low pricing

We have caught a number of notable deals on the 4-pack, but for folks who just don’t need four of them, Amazon’s early fall Prime Day sale is still offering Apple’s 2026 AirTag 2 down at its lowest price to date in brand new condition.

While we aren’t talking about a giant discount here at $24 Prime shipped, keep in mind this is a 2026 Apple release that was already only $29.

  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29) – Matching all-time low

You can still score a discount on the 4-pack at $89 – that’s $22.50 apiece, but we have seen it down $9 lower more than a few times now over the last couple months, and we might very well again in the coming week for fall Prime Day.

Most affordable 2026 Studio Display models are up to $300 off straight from Apple refurb today

Alongside the ongoing early fall Prime Day sale at Amazon, the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is delivering some notable offers on the most affordable 2026 Apple Studio Display – the Tilt-adjustable stand is $240 off and the Tilt- and Height-Adjustable Stand is $300 off.

The official Apple refurb store is now once again offering the 2026 Apple Studio Display with the Tilt-adjustable stand down at $1,359 shipped. This one carries a $1,599 list price and is now $240 off the list price – it is currently selling for $1,550 at Amazon where it has never dropped below $1,484.

And you’ll find the 2026 model Tilt- and Height-Adjustable Stand down at $1,699 shipped. This is a $1,999 display that is now a solid $300 off the list and well below the $1,984 Amazon is asking for right now – this one has never sold for less than $1,886 in new condition at Amazon.

You’ll find them waiting on the brand’s official Amazon storefront and in detail down below.

Eve is one of the brand’s that does offer deals throughout the year, but it’s really during these special sale events when the prices really start to drop. Loads of its multi smart home platform Matter-ready gear, from outlets and smart plugs to light switches, water/leak detectors, motion sensors, and even the Motionblinds are now on sale for fall Prime Day.

All-new 2026 Kindle lineup

Amazon also gave its Kindle lineup a pretty broad refresh for 2026, with new versions of the standard Kindle, Paperwhite, and Colorsoft all making their debut. The updated models bring flush-front displays, slimmer designs, and a handful of upgrades depending on the version, including faster performance, higher-contrast screens, and new aluminum-backed options. The prices for these updated models start at $149.99 shipped for the standard Kindle, while the Paperwhite and Colorsoft start at $199.99 and $289.99, respectively. Amazon also added some new accessories to the mix, including the Kindle Click Bluetooth page-turn remote.
